features.name: PassengerId
features.description: Unique row identifier; no predictive signal.

features.name: Pclass
features.description: Ticket class (1/2/3); proxy for socioeconomic status and physical deck location.

features.name: Name
features.description: Free-text passenger name; not used directly, but the source column for Title extraction.

features.name: Age
features.description: Age in years. Nullable on input; TitanicPreprocessor fills missing values with the fitted per-Title training median, never a static default.

features.name: Ticket
features.description: Ticket number; high-cardinality identifier with no clean signal.

features.name: Fare
features.description: Fare paid; right-skewed (flagged for a log-transform check in Stage 2).

features.name: Cabin
features.description: 77% missing. Not used directly — decomposed into HasCabin and Deck instead.

features.name: Embarked
features.description: Port of embarkation. Nullable on input; TitanicPreprocessor fills missing values with the fitted training-split mode (currently 'S').

features.name: HasCabin
features.description: 1 if a cabin was recorded, 0 otherwise.

features.name: FamilySize
features.description: Total family members aboard including the passenger; non-monotonic effect on survival (see reports/stage1_data_audit.md).

features.name: IsAlone
features.description: 1 if traveling without any family aboard. Deterministic function of FamilySize.

features.name: Title
features.description: Honorific extracted from Name; titles occurring <10 times in the training split (or never seen at fit time) collapse to 'Rare'.

features.name: FarePerPerson
features.description: Estimated per-individual fare, adjusting for group ticket pricing. Divide-by-zero guarded.

features.name: Deck
features.description: First letter of Cabin; 'U' where Cabin is missing, 'Other' where an unseen deck letter appears at inference. Highly redundant with HasCabin.

features.name: AgeGroup
features.description: Age binned into Child (<=12) / Teen (13-18) / Adult (19-59) / Senior (60+).

notes: Promoted to schema_version 2.0.0 by model/train_v2.py per the Stage 3 decision review and Stage 4/5 validation. SibSp/Parch remain required raw inputs (used to compute FamilySize) but are no longer direct model features; IsAlone was dropped as redundant with FamilySize.
